claims.location: source name all data rows 1-2344 (header excluded)
claims.evidence: Each source is one SILAC channel (pre-existing K0 or newly synthesised K6 proteome) of one mouse x one biochemical protein fraction (or plasma) of one of the five cohorts; the _K0-light/_K6-heavy suffix keeps the (source, biological replicate, technical replicate, fraction) coordinate unique while both channels stay the same mouse (identical characteristics). Cohort = the search zip; mouse id and fraction are parsed from the MaxQuant Experiment names in summary.txt (e.g. "834 wt DOCmem", "299-GDN-det", "4-Tg-cyt"); for P186 TXmem/GDNdet and P548 numbered experiments the mouse id is carried in the raw-file names (_44_/_45_/_46_/_59_/_66_/_69_ = WT-744/745/746, KI-059/066/069 as named in the P186 DOC/Tx experiments; _635_/_636_/_637_ = "1/2/3-DOCmem-Wt", _021_/_297_/_371_ = "4/5/6-DOCmem-Tg"). Plasma of P285, P548 and P120 is keyed by the experiment index (plasma1..6 / mouse1..6) because the plasma file names do not carry the brain mouse ids.

limitations: In this in vivo pulse (SILAM) design both SILAC channels of a run come from the same mouse; the light and heavy rows are given distinct source names (suffix _K0-light/_K6-heavy) only so that the row coordinate (source, biological replicate, technical replicate, fraction) is unique. They are not different animals.

Age (postnatal day: P113, P285, P186, P548, P120) has no licensed column in ms-proteomics + vertebrates (+ clinical-metadata); it is carried only in the source name prefix. characteristics[developmental stage]=adult is inferred from the stated ages.
Sex is not reported per mouse (paper: "age-, sex-, and genetic background-matched"): written not available.
Strain/background of TgCRND8, AppNL-F and SOD1-G93A lines is not stated; characteristics[strain or breed] = not available.

14 deposited raw files (MMD1780A147LC3_C7 ... MMD1780A160LC3_H8) are assigned in the deposited MaxQuant searches to both 350-GDN-det (fractions 3-16) and 352-tri-sol (fractions 3-16) of P113; left out, so P113 sources model_350 GDN and model_352 TritonX100-sol carry only fractions 1-2.

52 runs that were searched (MMD1983*, MMD1987*: P186 DOC/Triton-prec K6 searches incl. WT-REM) are not deposited; the deposited MMD2102* runs (DOC-/Tx- experiments of the same mice) are annotated instead.

Plasma runs of P285, P548 and P120 cannot be linked to the brain mouse ids; they are separate sources keyed by experiment index, so biological replicate n of plasma and of brain in those cohorts is not asserted to be the same animal.

Detergent/protein fraction (DOC-solubilised, Triton X-100 precipitate/solubilised, GDN, homogenate supernatant) is encoded only in the source name; no SDRF column fits it. For P120 the MaxQuant "TXdet" fraction is written TritonX100-sol, following Table S7 ("Fraction 3 (Triton X-100 sol.)").
Biological replicate numbers are animal identifiers (1-42), not within-group indices. The five experiments are distinguished by comment[sample preparation batch].

Search settings vary between MaxQuant folders (MaxQuant 1.5.0.0 vs 1.5.0.12; P113 txt_K6_1/2 searched a human reference FASTA; P113 txt_K6_2 used only Oxidation (M), 0 missed cleavages); the modification set annotated is the majority set, also stated in the paper.
Precursor tolerance (20 ppm) is from the paper; MaxQuant parameters.txt does not print the main-search precursor tolerance.
characteristics[disease] for mouse models is the modelled human disease; controls are normal.
